switches: License: from each state's form. Where a state or city licenses detailing or mobile washing, its form asks for it (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie).

Insurance: shown only once the owner sends proof. A building or parking garage that asks for proof gets the certificate on file.

pf.services.sizes: Every package is priced and timed by the car's size: sedan; mid-size (small SUVs, wagons); large (big SUVs, vans, full-size trucks). The year, make and model set the size.

pf.services.surcharges: Set by the customer's answers and shown in the first price: heavy pet hair +$50 and 30 minutes, smoke odor +$75 and 45 minutes, heavy mud or sand +$40 and 30 minutes (example prices). Not sure: booked without it, agreed at the visit with photos.
pf.services.extras: Travel: free within 15 miles, $25 more up to the travel area's edge (example). Add-ons only when the customer asks.
pf.services.not_offered: Blood, needles or other body fluids (biohazard cleaning), window tint and body or paint repair unless the license list covers them.
pf.services.capacity: One detailer per car; the shop takes a set number of cars a day (drop-off slots).
pf.services.skills: Interior, exterior, paint polish and coating (only some detailers), pressure washing.
pf.services.nobody_home: A plan's maintenance wash or an exterior detail can be done with nobody there, if the car is reachable (driveway or office lot) and any key is left as agreed.
pf.services.promise: The example business's quality promise: a missed spot found at the walk-through is fixed before leaving; one reported within 3 days gets a free touch-up of about 30 minutes.
pf.services.custom: Work the list doesn't fit, like a paint correction (a machine polish for swirl marks), is priced for that car by the detailer after a look at the paint, and the owner OKs it. It's booked as its own visit, with a 25% deposit (example: $640 for a mid-size car).

pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult (18 or older) who may have the car worked on: the owner, or someone with the owner's OK. A fleet manager may book for a company's cars.

pf.safety.stop: Blood, needles or other body fluids in the car: no booking. Rosie says a biohazard cleaning company is the right call, and to call 911 if anyone is hurt.
pf.safety.steps_then_go_on: Broken glass in the car, like after a break-in: keep children out of the car and don't reach in bare-handed; the booking goes on, and the detailer vacuums the glass first.
pf.safety.general: The general screen stays on: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency or self-harm.

pf.first_steps.prep_in_reminder: Take out valuables and car seats. For a coating, the garage is cleared, and the car can stay in, dry, for 24 hours after.

pf.visit.check_in: At the customer's place: the code at the door or by the car, from the detailer's phone. At the shop: the code at the counter when the car and keys are left; READY when it's done; the code again at pick-up.
pf.visit.before_work: A walk-around with before photos of every panel and the inside. Scratches, dents and stains already there are noted.
pf.visit.water_power: The customer's outside tap and outlet, or the van's own tank and generator, at no charge. Wash water is caught on a mat and taken away; a waterless wash is used where washing isn't allowed.
pf.visit.cold_mornings: Inside first, outside once it warms up.
pf.visit.worse_than_booked: More pet hair, smoke or mud than booked: photos, the surcharge's price and the new finish time go to the customer. It's added only after a yes. No reply in 15 minutes: only the booked detail is done.
pf.visit.no_access: The car isn't there and nobody answers: the detailer waits 15 minutes, then leaves. The no-access fee is the owner's call.
pf.visit.done: A walk-through with after photos from the same angles. DONE proves it; the photos go with the receipt.

pf.money.starting_answers: At the customer's place: a card saved for the late-cancel or no-access fee (there's no trip fee to hold), paid after by the bill Rosie texts (a pay link, the saved card, or cash). Plans and nobody-there visits are paid the same way, on the bill after each visit. At the shop: a card saved for the shop's no-show fee, paid at the counter at pick-up. Ceramic coatings: a 25% deposit, held until the owner OKs it, the rest after.
pf.money.fees: Late cancel or no access: the business's own fee (example: $89 mobile, $20 at the shop), only after the owner confirms it.
pf.money.caps: Deposit cap: from the state form. Fee limits: from the state form.
pf.money.tips: On: a tip line on the bill; tips go to the detailer.
pf.money.tax: Where the state taxes the service: the rate from the state form.
pf.money.dollar2: Pays Rosfield's $2 a booking; a plan counts once a month.

pf.messages.never_in_texts: Gate, garage or lockbox codes, where the keys are, and the license plate. They stay on the secure page.
pf.messages.minors: A teen never books; a parent books for a teen's car.

pf.staff.license: No person license by default; where a state's form asks for one, each detailer gives it in the invite reply.
pf.staff.skills: Interior, exterior, paint polish and ceramic coating, pressure washing. Only detailers with the coating skill are offered for coatings.
pf.staff.supervision: None by default. Driving the van is the business's own check, not Rosie's.
pf.staff.oks: The owner OKs every coating and every price made for one customer over his amount.

switches: Wash water: where the city's rules ban wash water reaching the street or a storm drain, the water is caught and taken away, or a waterless wash is used (from the state and city form).
HOA, building and office rules: asked at booking; a no-washing rule switches the outside to a waterless wash at the same price.
Repeating plans: any notice or yearly reminder the state's rules require, from its form.
Extra work sold at the customer's place: a written right to cancel where the state's rules require it.
Written estimate or contract above an amount: where the state's rules require it.
Records: 7 years, or as the state's rules require.

pf.edges.weather: Outside work only when dry and above the business's limit (example: 40°F). The forecast is checked the day before; moving for weather is always free. Garage work has no limit.
pf.edges.access: No car or no keys at the visit: handled like nobody home, with the no-access fee as the owner's call.
pf.edges.no_washing: An HOA, building or city that bans washing: a waterless wash, same price and time.
pf.edges.damage: A damage claim is checked against the before photos.
pf.edges.coating_cure: A coating must stay dry 24 hours: the reminder and the aftercare tips say so.
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases the generic way.
pf.edges.left_behind: A car not picked up by closing stays inside the shop. Two reminders; after the free days Sam sets (example: a week), a storage fee only if Sam starts it, after written notice where the state's rules require it.
